title: Five Nights at Freddy's
summary: A night guard, Mike Schmidt, works a week at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza while its four machines roam at night. A recorded voice on the phone guides him and mentions "the Bite of '87", and rare newspaper clippings report children lured into a back room and never found.
settingYearLabel: A November after 1987 (the cheques print the year as 'xx')

title: Five Nights at Freddy's 2
summary: A night guard, Jeremy Fitzgerald, works the last week of a new Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, among new machines and four older ones kept for parts. The phone calls report an investigation, a lockdown and a spare yellow suit that someone used. Minigames that can follow a death show a child killed outside a party, the Puppet giving masks to dead children, and a purple man.

title: Five Nights at Freddy's 3
summary: A guard works at Fazbear's Fright, a horror attraction built from the old restaurants' relics around one real find: a yellow rabbit suit with a body inside it. Minigames between the nights show a purple man dismantling the four old machines and dying inside that suit.
settingYearLabel: Thirty years after Freddy Fazbear's Pizza closed (Scott's store text; no year)

title: Five Nights at Freddy's 4
summary: The player defends a bedroom at night against monstrous versions of the Fazbear characters. Minigames between the nights count down five days to a small boy's birthday party, where Fredbear's jaws close on his head. The game ends on a locked box.
settingYearLabel: c. 1983 (the year on a television show's title card)

title: Five Nights at Freddy's 4: Halloween Edition
summary: A seasonal edition of FNaF4 with changed characters and redecorated minigames. Scott ruled it non-canon.

title: FNaF World
summary: A comic role-playing game starring 'adventure' versions of the characters. Its adventure is outside the story; its opening words and its clock ending echo FNaF4 on purpose and are used only as support.
settingYearLabel: Outside the story, except its frame voice

title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Sister Location
summary: A technician works five nights in Circus Baby's Entertainment and Rental, an underground facility marked Afton Robotics whose machines are hired out for parties. Circus Baby guides him to the scooping room. Cutscenes unlocked in its Custom Night show what became of him, and end with a son's speech to his father.
settingYearLabel: Undated; after a Freddy Fazbear's Pizza had closed

title: Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator
summary: A franchisee runs a new pizzeria for one week and is offered wrecked machines to salvage. The restaurant is a trap: the Cassette Man calls four haunted machines into one building and stays as it burns.
settingYearLabel: After the Fazbear's Fright fire (no year)

title: Ultimate Custom Night
summary: A custom night with fifty selectable characters from the earlier games. Many of their lines speak to the player as someone who is being kept there, and one voice says it will hold the player there "no matter how many times they burn us".
settingYearLabel: After the Pizzeria Simulator fire (no year)

title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Help Wanted
summary: A virtual-reality game presented as Fazbear Entertainment's own product, the Freddy Fazbear Virtual Experience, which restages the earlier games as fiction. Hidden tapes left by a tester describe something that came into its code from scanned circuit boards.
settingYearLabel: Undated; after the Pizzeria Simulator fire by convention

title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Help Wanted - Curse of Dreadbear
summary: A Halloween add-on to Help Wanted: new levels in the same virtual product. With a hidden rabbit mask on, the player hears a woman's side of a conversation with someone who is never heard.

title: Five Nights at Freddy's AR: Special Delivery
summary: An augmented-reality mobile game in which the Fazbear Funtime Service sends the company's machines to subscribers' homes. Misdirected company emails tell of a contractor's scan of old circuit boards that released a virus, and of an employee whose searches alarm a colleague.
settingYearLabel: Undated; its emails count only in their order

title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach
summary: A boy, Gregory, is shut in Freddy Fazbear's Mega Pizzaplex overnight. Glamrock Freddy helps him against the other machines, the guard Vanessa and a woman in a rabbit costume. The game has six endings, one of which goes down to a pizzeria buried under the building.

title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach - RUIN
summary: An add-on to Security Breach. Cassie goes into the wrecked Pizzaplex to find Gregory, led by a voice that uses his words, and switches off the security system that was keeping something sealed underneath.

title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Help Wanted 2
summary: A staff training program of tasks in the Mega Pizzaplex, seen through a mask; with the mask off, its bright hub is a dark, derelict room. In its main ending a gift on the hub's stage opens on a recharge station, and a robot holds a rabbit mask out to a girl.
settingYearLabel: Between Security Breach's night and RUIN

title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Into the Pit
summary: An adventure game, and an adaptation that the main games never place. A boy, Oswald, climbs into a ball pit at a run-down pizzeria and comes out in an older Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, and a yellow rabbit follows him back.
settingYearLabel: Not placed; a logo graphic reads 1985 (placement unconfirmed)

title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Secret of the Mimic
summary: Fazbear Entertainment sends a technician by night into the shuttered workshop of Murray's Costume Manor to bring out its blueprints, and an endoskeleton built to take on the character of any costume hunts him there. Recordings and letters tell the story of Edwin Murray, his family and his two machines.
settingYearLabel: 1979, most likely 7 September (on a work order in the technician's van, not yet seen in play)

title: Freddy in Space 2
summary: A comic side-scrolling shooter spin-off. The archive holds no records from it, and it is outside the story.
